title: Compat API v1.52: multi-platform, network Status, events Accept, df, stats, and related gaps
body:
Docker Engine API [v1.52](https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/engine/version-history/#v152-api-changes) still has several Compat gaps before we can treat 1.52 as covered under the parent epic (claim v1.55).
## Needs work
### Images / platforms
- [ ] Multi-`platform` query args on `GET /images/{name}/get` and `POST /images/load` (extends v1.48 single-platform gap)
- [ ] Omit empty image inspect `Parent` / `DockerVersion` / `Author` (today often always serialized as empty strings)
### Networking / create
- [ ] `GET /networks/{id}` `Status` (IPAM allocation stats)
- [ ] Empty `PortBindings` create warning (Docker deprecates auto-backfill of empty HostIP/HostPort)
- [ ] Reject or ignore container-wide `Config.MacAddress` on create for API >= 1.52 (endpoint-only)
### Events / stats / df
- [ ] Events content-type negotiation via `Accept`: `application/x-ndjson` and `application/json-seq` (today always `application/json`)
- [ ] `GET /containers/{id}/stats` `os_type`
- [ ] `/system/df?verbose=1`
- [ ] For API **1.52** clients, return **both** legacy df fields and new usage fields; legacy-only drop is v1.53
## Contributing
If you want to work on one checklist item, please open a focused issue (or PR) for that part and reference **this** issue (and the parent epic). Prefer one change area per PR. Events Accept work should also cover v1.53 `application/jsonl`.
